issues.description: The template declares Course.addRating(stars:) as a Void method (no return type), while the solution implements it returning Bool. The problem statement describes only the parameter and behavior but does not specify a return type. This mismatch can confuse students about the intended signature and may cause inconsistencies between student implementations and the provided solution/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the intended return type explicit and consistent across artifacts. Either: (A) Update the problem statement to state that addRating(stars:) should return Bool indicating success/failure and change the template method signature to `func addRating(stars: Int) -> Bool { ... }`; or (B) change the solution to use a Void return (no Bool) and keep the template as-is. Option A is preferred if callers/tests need a success indicator.
